■ 1. Introduction: The Eternal Key That Opens Genesis, God's Predestination
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When we open Genesis, the first book of the Bible, it is easy to limit our view to Genesis 1:1, "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth." But the apostle Paul proclaims an amazing mystery in Ephesians chapter 3. Before God made heaven and earth and all things, from eternity past, there was a "plan of the mystery" and a "predestined purpose" hidden within the triune God.

Human salvation is not a backup plan (Plan B) that God threw together in a panic after Adam ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil and sinned. Before He made all things, God had already foreseen the end of all history and the weakness of mankind, and He held in His heart the eternal blueprint (Plan A) of salvation through the atoning cross of His only begotten Son, Jesus Christ. Genesis is the beginning of grace, showing how this eternal predestination unfolds step by step in history, in time and space.

■ 2. Main Message: The Essential Meaning of Predestination and Election
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) Election is not an exclusive privilege but a mission for the whole world.
When people of the world hear the words "election and predestination," they misunderstand God as unfair. Why does He choose some and reject others? But the election the Bible speaks of is not a "monopoly on privilege."
God chose Abraham, one man among countless people in Ur of the Chaldeans, not so that only Abraham's family would be blessed and live well, but to make him a priestly channel of salvation for all peoples: "in you will all the families of the earth be blessed."
That we were called first today and came to believe in Jesus is not a merit to boast about either. It is the holy mission of a debtor, to lead our neighbors and the nations who do not yet know God to Christ.

2) God's sovereignty and human responsibility
The Bible's teaching on predestination never turns people into fatalistic robots. God rules history in His absolute sovereignty, yet at the same time He gave people a personal free will, because He wants them to love and obey Him with a willing heart.
The reason He placed the tree of the knowledge of good and evil before Adam was not oppression either; true love is completed not by force but through choice and obedience. God leads history with vast wisdom that works even our stumbling together for good.

3) God's wisdom made known through the church to the angels in heaven
In verse 10 Paul testifies, "that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places." As they watch fallen sinners washed by the blood of Jesus Christ, becoming holy children of God and forming the church, the angels of heaven and all the powers of the spiritual world cry out in wonder before God's unimaginable love and wisdom.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
As we go through life, there are times when we meet suffering and lose heart because of our own weakness. But remember this. My salvation is not rooted in my own decision or zeal. It is rooted in the eternal covenant and predestination of God, who pointed me out and called me before heaven and earth were even created.

"We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose." (Rom 8:28)

Dear saints studying Genesis, I bless you in the Lord: hold on to the bold assurance that God's love for you began in eternity past and continues into eternity, and today too, humbly obey the Lord's word and be people of faith who bless the world.

■ 1. Introduction: The Freedom of Eden and the Illusion of Modern People
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When God created the Garden of Eden, the state He gave to Adam and Eve was "complete freedom." They could freely eat the fruit of every tree in the garden; only the fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil they were not to eat.
Today many people mistake "doing whatever I want" for freedom. They ignore God's law, morals and conscience, and act according to the desires of their flesh, calling it freedom. But the Bible declares that this is not freedom but "license," a state of "slavery to sin."

■ 2. Main Message: The Three Pillars of True Freedom
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) The freedom given when we abide in the Word (If you remain in my word)
A fish is freest when it is in water, and a train is safest and freest when it runs on its rails. If a fish says, "Why should I be stuck in the water? I'm going out onto dry land," and jumps out onto the shore, it does not gain freedom; it meets death.
Human beings were created to enjoy the most complete and peaceful freedom when they live in the living water of God's word. Satan deceived Adam, saying, "If you eat the fruit, you will be free like God," but what awaited humans who left the fence of the Word was shame, fear, and the chains of death.

2) Set free from being slaves of sin into the standing of sons
In Jesus' day the Jews, though living under Roman colonial rule, were caught in spiritual pride, saying, "We have never been in bondage to anyone." Jesus struck right at the heart of it: "Everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin."
Sin first comes to us like sweet freedom, but in the end it captures a person's soul and character and makes them a slave of addiction and ruin they cannot escape. Slaves of money, slaves of pleasure, slaves of power, slaves of envy and jealousy: the only one who can set such people free is Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

3) The true freedom the Son gives
"If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed." The blood Jesus shed on the cross tore up the record of our debt of sin completely, and moved us from slavery to the devil into the standing of God's own children. Now we have received the Spirit of sonship, by which we call God "Abba, Father" without fear of condemnation and come boldly before the throne of grace.

■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Lift Your Freedom Up into Serving One Another in Love
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The apostle Paul urges us in Galatians 5:13: "For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don't use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another."
True Christian freedom is not the freedom to sin. It is the holy power to refuse sin and to love and serve God and our neighbors with joy.
Looking at the Garden of Eden in Genesis, may you be blessed saints who today too live within the bounds of the Word, enjoying the true freedom and peace the Lord has given.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) The mystery hidden in Adam's garments of skin
In Genesis chapter 3, Adam and Eve, having sinned, sewed fig leaves together into aprons to cover their shame. But when the sun beat down, the leaves soon crumbled. The garments of human good works and morality can never cover the shame of sin forever.
Then God shed the blood of an animal and made "garments of skin" to clothe them. This event of the first gospel, that a sinner's shame is covered only when an innocent lamb sheds its blood and gives up its skin, eloquently proclaims the mystery of Jesus Christ, who would one day shed His blood on the cross on the hill of Golgotha to cover all our sins.

2) The mystery hidden in Abraham's burnt offering on Mount Moriah
In Genesis chapter 22, God commands Abraham to offer Isaac, the only son he received at a hundred years old, as a burnt offering on Mount Moriah. When Abraham raised the knife to slay his son, God said, "Do not lay your hand on the boy," and had prepared a ram caught in a thicket by its horns.
"Jehovah Jireh (In the mount of the LORD it shall be provided)!" Mount Moriah, where father Abraham offered his only son, was the very place, Golgotha, where two thousand years later God the Father actually gave His only begotten Son Jesus Christ on the altar of the cross for all mankind.

3) The mystery hidden in Joseph's suffering and victory
Joseph was sold by his brothers for twenty pieces of silver, became a slave in Egypt, and was unjustly thrown into prison. But in the end he became prime minister, saved the whole starving world, and with tears forgave and embraced the very brothers who had sold him. His life is a perfect type of Jesus Christ, who was rejected by His own people and nailed to the cross, but rose again and ascended, became Lord of all, and embraces even those who pierced Him.

■ 1. Introduction: Why Did God Make the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Whether people are Christians or not, one of the questions they ask most about the Bible is this: "Why did God put the tree of the knowledge of good and evil in the Garden of Eden and make humans sin? If He had never made it at all, wouldn't there have been no fall and no suffering?"
But if we do not understand this tree deeply, we can never grasp the redemptive history of the Bible. The tree of the knowledge of good and evil was not a trap or a snare to tempt people and send them to hell. It was a "spiritual safety device" that upheld the holy relationship between God and His creature, man.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: God's Three Purposes in the Tree and the Nature of Temptation
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) The tree is a "boundary stone marking the creature's limits."
God handed over to Adam every authority in the Garden of Eden. He let him name every living creature, rule over the earth, and freely enjoy thousands and thousands of fruit trees. Man was the steward of Eden, its vice-king.
But as man became master of Eden, there was one single truth he must not forget: "You rule over the whole world, but there is a real King, the real God, who made you!" Every time he passed the middle of the garden and saw the tree, Adam could keep his place, saying, "Ah, God is there. I am His servant and His creature." The tree was a spiritual brake that kept man from becoming proud.

2) How Satan's temptation works: twisting the Word and planting the seed of doubt
Look at the first words Satan (the serpent) spoke when he approached Eve: "Has God really said, 'You shall not eat of any tree of the garden'?"
God had given abundant grace: "You may freely eat of every tree, only do not eat of this one." But Satan twists God into a stingy, petty God.
Eve falls for this temptation and alters God's word. She weakened the absolute command "you will surely die" into "lest you die," and she added words God never said: "You shall not touch it." Once the Word grew faint, Satan struck the decisive blow: "You won't really die! Your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God!"

3) The essence of sin: "the pride of trying to be like God"
When Eve looked at the tree, three kinds of greed blinded her eyes: good for food (the lust of the flesh), a delight to the eyes (the lust of the eyes), and desirable to make one wise (the pride of life).
In the end, eating that fruit was not simply stealing a piece of fruit. It was a massive rebellion, a coup against God the Creator: "From now on I will decide what is good and evil in my life! I will play God, without God interfering!"

■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Take Off the Fig Leaves and Put On the Garment of Grace
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What came to man the moment he ate the fruit was not wisdom like God's, but the shame of nakedness and the terror of hiding behind the trees from God. The fig-leaf aprons man sewed to save himself soon dried up and crumbled.
Dear saints, there are many such forbidden fruits in our lives today too: the pride that wants to run my life my own way, and the idols of money and honor that I have set in God's place.
Lay down at the cross the pride that tries to play God, put on the garment of righteousness of Jesus Christ, the Lamb who shed His blood for our sins, and enjoy true peace with God. I bless you in the name of the Lord.

■ 1. Introduction: The Great Watershed of Human History
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Genesis chapters 1 to 11 are the "primeval history" (Creation - Fall - Flood - Tower of Babel), which deals with all of mankind. When all mankind opposed God and was scattered at the Tower of Babel, human history seemed to end in pitch-black despair.
But in chapter 12 God begins an amazing reversal of salvation. Among the countless people of Ur of the Chaldeans, He points out and calls one man: Abram, a 75-year-old, childless man who served idols. This is the patriarchal history of the Bible, the majestic starting point of God's covenant of redemption to save all the peoples under heaven.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: Abraham's Call and the Three Steps of Faith
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) The decision to leave: "Leave your country, your relatives, and your father's house"
In the society of the ancient Near East, to leave your homeland, your relatives and your father's house meant giving up completely every social safety net and privilege that protected your life and property. Ur of the Chaldeans at the time was a splendid, wealthy city, the most advanced civilization in the world, which worshiped the moon god (Nanna).
God commands Abraham to abandon the comfortable ground of his old life and come out. True faith always begins with "leaving." Unless we lay down the world's values, sinful habits, and the human background we leaned on, we can never enter God's promised land.

2) Obedience toward what is unseen: "Go to the land that I will show you"
Hebrews 11:8 praises Abraham's faith this way: "By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went."
God did not first show him a specific destination address, a map, or a navigation system. He only gave an open-ended promise: "Go to the land that I will show you."
We want to move only after we have checked every result and it is guaranteed, but God's school of faith is following His leading step by step, hearing God's voice every day. More important than the destination is "who we walk with."

3) The mission to become a source of blessing: "You will be a blessing"
What was the ultimate purpose of God's promise to make Abraham a great nation and make his name great? "All the families of the earth will be blessed through you!"
In the original language it means "become a blessing yourself." The reason God gives us the blessings of material things, health and wisdom is not the prosperity religion of eating my fill and living in luxury on my own.
The true mission of the covenant people is to pass on the blessings I have received to my neighbors, and at last to become a "channel of blessing" through which all the peoples of the world meet the gospel of life, Jesus Christ, the Lord of salvation.

■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Following in the Footsteps of Abraham, the Father of Faith
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Galatians 3:7 proclaims: "Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham."
All of us who have received Jesus Christ as Savior today are spiritual children of Abraham. Even now God is looking for people of faith who, like Abraham, break out of their comfort zone, hold on to God's word alone as their lifeline, and obey.
Boldly leave the place of unbelief where you are staying, step out toward the path of promise where the Lord leads, and become a holy channel of blessing that passes blessing on to all the peoples under heaven. This is my earnest prayer for you.

When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain. Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, 'This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel: "You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself. Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine; and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation." These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.'" (Exod 19:1-6)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 1. Introduction: The Sinai Covenant, the Watershed of All 66 Books of the Bible
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
In the Ezra Bible Course, the text of all texts that Pastor Woo-ho Noh raises his voice most to emphasize is the Sinai covenant in Exodus chapter 19.
Exodus is not just a drama about freeing slaves. The destination toward which God led His people, crossing the Red Sea, feeding them with manna and quail, guiding them with the pillar of cloud and the pillar of fire, was this very "Mount Sinai."
Mount Sinai is the covenant sanctuary where God held the most majestic and holy "covenant of blood" in history with His people, in other words, a spiritual "wedding." Without knowing this Sinai covenant, we can never interpret Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, Kings, or the whole of the Prophets that follow.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: The Three Constitutional Visions of a Kingdom of Priests and a Holy Nation
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) Looking back on the grace of salvation: "I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you"
Before giving the law and the commandments, God first reminds them of the grace they received.
Just as a mother eagle, training her young, drops it from a high cliff and, just as it is about to fall because its wing beats are still clumsy, swoops down like an arrow beneath it and carries it up on her wings, so God Himself carried His people on His wings and saved them through the ten plagues of Egypt and at the Red Sea.
The law is not a heavy burden given as a condition for being saved. It is the "rule of love" that a holy people, already saved freely, keep out of thankfulness for grace.

2) God's special treasure: "You shall be my own possession (segullah)"
The Hebrew word segullah, translated "my own possession," means the "special personal treasure" that ancient kings cherished and hid away in the innermost treasure room of the palace.
The whole universe and everything in it belongs to God, but this is a moving promise: the Lord's people who listen closely to God's word and keep the covenant will be regarded in God's eyes as His most precious, brilliantly shining special treasure.

3) A worldwide mission to lead all peoples to God: "You shall be a kingdom of priests"
What is the role of a priest? A bridge that mediates between sinners and God and reconciles them.
God is not a narrow god who called only the one nation of Israel to save it and send all other nations to hell. He planted Israel in the land of Canaan, the main highway of the world, so that the nations of the world (Egypt, Assyria, Babylon and others) would see them living justly and holily according to God's law and say, "Truly the LORD God is the true God!" and turn back to God. He made Israel a "priestly nation."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: The Royal Priesthood Handed Down to New Testament Believers
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The proclamation of Exodus 19:6 is passed on fully to 1 Peter 2:9 in the New Testament.
"But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light."

Dear saints, who are we today?
We are a "royal priesthood" who must testify to God's holiness in the middle of a dark world and lead the people of the world to God. Our homes, our workplaces, our jobs are the places of our priestly ministry.
Engrave the holy covenant of Sinai on your hearts, and like God's special treasure, be people of a true kingdom of priests who light up the world with pure and righteous lives. I bless you in the Lord.

■ 1. Introduction: The Tabernacle, the Dwelling Place Where God Lives Among Us
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
From Exodus chapter 25 to the last chapter, 40, the Bible records the blueprint of the tabernacle and how it was made in great detail.
Why did God give so many pages to having the tabernacle built?
"Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them." (Exod 25:8)
The tabernacle is the sanctuary of God's presence: the holy God pitches a tent right in the middle of His sinful people to dwell with them and have fellowship with them.
The ultimate purpose of the Exodus was not simply freeing slaves, but forming a holy community that lives with God.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: The Work of the Holy Spirit and True Devotion Seen in Building the Tabernacle
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) Craftsmen filled with the Spirit of God: Bezalel and Oholiab
When the tabernacle was built, God did not make Moses do all the work alone. He named Bezalel, the grandson of Hur of the tribe of Judah, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan, and "filled them with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge," to devise all kinds of skilled work.
God's work is not done with worldly skill or connections. When each person serves carefully according to the gift entrusted to them, with the inspiration and wisdom of the Holy Spirit, the beautiful church, the body of the Lord, is built up.

2) Devotion overflowing from willing hearts: "sufficient for all the work, and too much"
The people of Israel did not give their offerings because Moses forced them or made unreasonable demands. Everyone whose heart was stirred willingly brought gold, silver, bronze, blue, purple and scarlet yarn, skins and precious stones, morning after morning.
As a result a miracle happened: the craftsmen building the tabernacle came to Moses and asked, "The people are bringing far too much, more than enough to use; please command them to stop bringing it."
Here is the very model by which the offerings and service of the Korean church must be restored: not out of saving face or obligation, but as joyful, willing devotion moved by the grace of redemption through the cross.

3) The glory of the LORD fills the tent of meeting
When the tabernacle was finished and every piece of furniture was put in place according to God's word, what happened?
Exodus 40:34: "Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle. Moses wasn't able to enter into the tent of meeting!"
When the tabernacle was built in complete obedience to the Word, the glory of God's presence came down and filled it like a cloud. When the cloud lifted, the people set out; when it stayed, they camped. God Himself became the navigation system for the road of their lives.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Our Bodies Are the Temple of the Holy Spirit
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
In the New Testament age, how was the Old Testament tabernacle fulfilled?
"The Word became flesh, and lived among us (pitched His tent among us). We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth." (John 1:14)
Jesus Christ became the true tabernacle, and now the body of each believer redeemed by Jesus' blood has become "the temple of God," where the Holy Spirit dwells (1 Cor 3:16).
Drive greed and the idols of the world out of the temple of your heart, and set your life apart in holiness every day so that God's holy presence and the rule of His Word fill it. I bless you in the Lord.

[성경 본문]\n\"여호와께서 회막에서 모세를 부르시고 그에게 말씀하여:
[Scripture]
"The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying, 'Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, "When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock. If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD. He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him..." For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life." (Lev 1:1-4, 17:11)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 1. Introduction: Leviticus, the Holiest Book of the 66 Books of the Bible
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Many Christians start reading through the Bible, read Genesis and the first half of Exodus with great interest, and then, when they enter Leviticus, get stuck in all kinds of complicated sacrificial laws and purification rules and give up halfway.
But Pastor Woo-ho Noh declares, "If you don't know Leviticus, you can never know the depth of the gospel of the cross."
Leviticus has only one core theme: "You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy" (Lev 11:45).
How can the holy God live together with unholy sinners?
The only solution is "the sacrifice of shed blood" and "a pure, holy life."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: The Mystery of the Cross's Redemption in the Burnt Offering (Olah)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) Preparing an offering without blemish
A burnt offering given to God must never be sick or have a blemish. They had to bring a bull, sheep or goat without blemish to the door of the tent of meeting.
This foreshadows that Jesus Christ, who would one day bear the sins of all mankind, had to be a perfectly righteous one, without blemish and without spot (1 Pet 1:19).

2) Laying on of hands (Semikhah) and the transfer of sin
The most important act in offering a sacrifice is that the worshiper himself places both hands on the animal's head, the "laying on of hands."
"God, I transfer to this sinless lamb my sins of pride, greed and lies. I deserve to die, but this lamb dies in my place."
The moment the laying on of hands is finished, the sin passes over to the lamb. The priest only looks on; the sinner himself cuts the animal's throat to shed its blood, skins it and cuts it into pieces.
It is a time to witness with his whole body how terrible and wretched the sin he committed is.

3) A pleasing aroma, burning up everything and offering it up
The burnt offering (Hebrew olah) means "that which goes up." The fat, the inner parts and all the meat are placed on the altar and burned up, with nothing left over.
This means complete devotion to God, total submission.
It points to the sacrifice of perfect obedience of Jesus, who prayed in the Garden of Gethsemane, "not as I will, but as you desire," and poured out water and blood on the cross.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Present Your Bodies as a Holy Living Sacrifice
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
In Romans 12:1 the apostle Paul applies the spirit of the burnt offering in Leviticus to our lives like this.
"Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service."
We no longer need to shed the blood of animals, because Jesus became the eternal sacrifice for sin once for all (Heb 10:12).
But every morning we must live the life of a spiritual burnt offering, a "living sacrifice," laying our own selfishness and self on the altar of the cross and burning it up.
May you have a blessed day in which my will dies and Christ lives. I bless you in the Lord.

These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart; and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes. You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates." (Deut 6:4-9)

■ 1. Introduction: Moses' Tearful Last Words Poured Out on the Plains of Moab
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
In the Korean name of Deuteronomy, 申命記 (Sinmyeonggi), the character "sin" is not 新, meaning "new," but 申, meaning "again": "to repeat the words and urge them earnestly."
The first Exodus generation all fell and died during forty years in the wilderness because of their unbelief and grumbling at Kadesh Barnea.
Now, on the plains of Moab with the entry into Canaan right before their eyes, Moses gathers the children of the new second Exodus generation, born in the wilderness, and gives his farewell sermon with a heart that pours out his very lifeblood.
"Do not abandon the Word and fall into idols and perish like your fathers! If you want to live, if you want to be blessed, listen only to the word of the LORD!"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: The Core of Deuteronomy's Theology - the Shema and the Conditions of the Covenant
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) Hear (Shema) - listening is the beginning of faith
The Hebrew word Shema is not simply receiving a sound with the ears; it includes the meaning "listen carefully and obey with your whole body."
Fallen human ears are quick to perk up at the world's temptations and fake news, but easily close before God's word.
Faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ. Blessed are those who listen closely to God's word and understand its meaning.

2) Whole-person love: with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your might
The love God wants is not a formal religious hobby that ends after one hour of worship on Sunday.
- Heart (Lev): the center of mind and emotion
- Soul (Nefesh): life and the whole soul
- Might (Meod): every capacity I have, such as talents, possessions and time
It is a command to give our whole being, put God in the very first place, and love Him.

3) Passing the Word on to the next generation (teaching our children)
Moses commands that teaching the Word to our children be put first, above any cram-school education or worldly success.
"When you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up!"
At the dinner table, at bedtime, in the car, parents must first prove God's word with their lives and teach it to their children; then the family lives and the nation prospers. The moment the passing on of faith is cut off, the next generation quickly falls into the dark generation of the Book of Judges.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Obeying the Word Is the Only Way to Prosper
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Deuteronomy chapter 28 sharply contrasts the blessings of obedience with the curses of disobedience.
If you carefully listen to God's word and keep and do His commands, you will be blessed in the city and blessed in the field; the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground will be blessed; you will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
Blessing is not something we chase after; it is the fruit of grace that follows naturally when we abide in the Word.
Today, in every area of our lives, listen to the Lord's word, obey it completely, and enjoy the blessings of the covenant in abundance. I bless you in the Lord.
복음에 나타난 하나님의 의: The Righteousness of God Revealed in the Gospel
[성경 본문]\n\"내가 복음을 부끄러워하지 아니하노니 이 복음은 모든:
[Scripture]
"For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek. For in it is revealed God's righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, 'But the righteous shall live by faith.'" (Rom 1:16-17)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 1. Introduction: The Spark of the Reformation and the Great Charter of the Christian Gospel
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Romans is the crown of the New Testament Epistles and the book that has brought about the greatest change in all of church history.
The word that turned Augustine from a dissolute life into a saint, the text that made Martin Luther cast off the false salvation of indulgences and raise high the torch of the Reformation, was Romans 1:17.
To the church in Rome, the heart of the Roman Empire, the apostle Paul lays out in clear order the amazing mystery of the gospel of God, who saves all the peoples under heaven without distinction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: The Grace of Justification by Faith
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) The gospel is the power (Dunamis) of God
In Paul's day Rome ruled the world with mighty military power, law, and splendid philosophy. Before that vast empire, the story of Jesus executed on a cross looked foolish and shameful in the eyes of the world.
But Paul boldly proclaims, "I am not ashamed of the Good News!"
The world's power and money cannot solve the problem of human sin and cannot overcome the fear of death. Only the gospel of the cross of Jesus Christ is "the power of God" (dunamis, from which the word "dynamite" comes), like a bomb, that brings sinners to life and gives them eternal life as a gift.

2) The righteousness of God (Dikaiosyne Theou) is revealed
All human good works, self-denial and keeping of the law are nothing but filthy rags when they stand before God's holy mirror (Isa 64:6).
Romans 3:23: "For all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God!"
To people locked in despair, God Himself gave heaven's solution.
It is not humans producing righteousness by themselves, but the "righteousness of grace" that God freely clothes on those who believe in the righteousness Jesus Christ completed on the cross.

3) The righteous shall live by faith
Quoting the prophecy of the prophet Habakkuk (Hab 2:4), Paul declares:
The only channel by which we are declared righteous before God is not our family, education, wealth, or good works, but only a living faith that confesses Jesus Christ as Lord.
This faith is not mere intellectual agreement; it is a decision of the whole person to hand the steering wheel of my life to the Lord and live in obedience to His word.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Do Not Receive Grace in Vain; Devote Yourselves as Instruments of Righteousness
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Just because we were declared righteous freely, we must never fall into the license of the "Salvation Sect," thinking that since we are saved we can now sin as we please.
Paul cries out in Romans chapter 6: "What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!"
The more freely salvation is received, the more precious that grace is.
Now do not give your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God. May you be such holy saints. I bless you in the Lord.
새 하늘과 새 땅 - 보라 내가 만물을 새롭게 하노라: A New Heaven and a New Earth - Behold, I Make All Things New
[성경 본문]\n\"또 내가 새 하늘과 새 땅을 보니 처음 하늘과 처음:
[Scripture]
"I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more. I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, made ready like a bride adorned for her husband. I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, 'Behold, God's dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.'... He who sits on the throne said, 'Behold, I am making all things new.'... He who testifies these things says, 'Yes, I come quickly.' Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus (Maranatha)." (Rev 21:1-5, 22:20)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 1. Introduction: The Glorious Grand Finale of the Redemptive History of the 66 Books of the Bible
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
If Genesis begins with "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth" and shows the pain of man's fall and the loss of paradise, Revelation ends with the brilliant finale of "a new heaven and a new earth," where the paradise that was taken away is fully restored and at last completed.
Many people misunderstand Revelation as a book full of terrifying judgment, monsters, and the fear of the end, and they avoid reading it.
But Revelation is a "gospel of victory," written to give persecuted believers of the early church the warmest comfort and hope: "Do not be shaken in any suffering! In the end our Lord Jesus Christ will win, and the forces of evil will be destroyed forever!"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message: Three Glorious Promises of the New Heaven and the New Earth
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1) God's dwelling is with people (Immanuel completed)
The most essential blessing of the New Jerusalem is not streets of gold or walls of jewels.
"Behold, God's dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them!"
Humans, who were cut off from God by sinning in the Garden of Eden, are restored by the blood of Jesus Christ, and at last the "eternal walk with God" is completed, in which they have close fellowship with God face to face forever.

2) The end of all tears, pain and death
Revelation 21:4 is God's tender declaration of comfort, which no literature in the world can imitate.
"He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away!"
The countless tears we shed keeping the faith on this earth, the injustices, the pain of sickness and of losing loved ones: the Lord Himself will wipe them away with His own hand.
Eternal life and rest are prepared, with no more cancer, no more partings, no more funerals.

3) The spring of the water of life and the inheritance of those who overcome
The Lord gives the spring of the water of life freely to the thirsty and declares:
"He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son!"
To the saints who kept faithful in their faith and won, even amid the world's persecution and the temptation to compromise, God gives the inheritance of the whole universe as the inheritance of sons.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Conclusion and Application: Maranatha! The Spirituality of the Bride Waiting for the Lord's Return
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The very last prayer of the Bible is the overflowing response of the saints.
"He who testifies these things says, 'Yes, I come quickly.' Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!"
Today we are living in the last days. The world is growing darker and darker, lawlessness is increasing, and love is growing cold.
But the saints do not despair, because they know that the deeper the darkness, the nearer the dawn.
Like the five wise virgins who prepared their oil, keep the holiness of a bride made ready, and be the Lord's watchful saints who prepare the way for the Lord's return every day and spread the gospel. I earnestly bless you in the name of the Lord.

■ 1. Introduction: God's Longing Voice Heard from the Scene of History
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Peace be with you, everyone. When we open the Bible, the first thing we must do is lay down completely at the cross the shallow knowledge and preconceptions in our heads, and our own pride. The Bible is never the product of idle philosophers gathering to muse. It is the living voice of God, who cried out as if pouring out His blood to save His people, right in the middle of bloody human history, in the desperate scenes of real life.

Imagine for a moment the background of [${bookName}], which we will look at today. Look at the appalling reality the people of Israel faced at the time: endless invasions by foreign powers and terrible corruption within, and the stubborn and ugly sinful nature of people who worshiped idols the moment they opened their eyes and raced toward destruction. God could have judged and swept away in one stroke those who betrayed Him and ran away so often, but in the end He could not give up His love. Instead He diligently sent His servants the prophets to point out their sins, and pleaded with longing, "Come back, please come back and live."

${summary}

The text we read today, ${scripture}, is also not a dead letter that only echoed in the land of Israel two or three thousand years ago. It is the living Word that sharply shatters the complacency of the Korean church and its believers today, who are spiritually asleep, soaked in materialism and worldly pleasure. It is the word of God, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow. As the Lord sternly commanded, "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies," I earnestly hope that in this hour your hearts will be fully opened and you will deeply meet God's longing heart.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Main Message 1: In-Depth Exposition of the Text -
언약에 신실하신 하나님의 주권적 사랑: God's sovereign love, faithful to His covenant
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
So then, what is the first core message today's text gives us?
Meditate deeply on the verses of the text, one by one. Here we come face to face with the character of the faithful God, on a completely different level from fickle and selfish human nature.

Even if heaven and earth pass away, God surely fulfills in history the words of the covenant He has once spoken with His mouth, without missing one jot or one tittle. How were the promises to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the Old Testament, and the eternal covenant He made with David, fulfilled? At every crisis people doubted God, broke the covenant, and ran off toward the world. But God was faithful to the end. He used even human failure and rebellion as tools of His providence to complete His great redemptive history.

Look back on your lives. If our salvation depended on my paltry feelings, my moral achievements, or my religious zeal, we could not have assurance of salvation for even a single day. But our salvation has dropped its firm anchor in the faithfulness of God, who called us by name from eternity past. Because God began it, God will complete it. I believe that when we fully acknowledge this great and vast sovereignty of God and bow down before it, then every fear, anxiety and worry that weighs on our lives will leave without a trace.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 3. Main Message 2: A Warning for Our Times -
형식적 종교주의와 영적 나태에 대한 엄중한 질책: A stern rebuke of formal religiosity and spiritual laziness
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Second, what does the text warn us about?
Everyone, do you know what God finds most detestable and hates most throughout the Bible? It is "religious sacrifice with the heart gone out of it" and "hypocritical worship that is only an empty shell."

Look at the people of Israel in the past. They wore down the temple threshold bringing countless animals to offer burnt offerings and peace offerings. They gathered at every feast and held splendid religious events. But in their everyday lives they oppressed orphans and widows, cheated with their weights, and were full of greed and immorality. Then God spoke through the prophets Isaiah and Malachi as if pouring out His blood:
"What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?... Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors!" (Isa 1:11, Mal 1:10). God's heart was torn to pieces.

What do we look like today? On Sunday we come to the sanctuary with our Bibles under our arms, looking holy, and sit down. But from Monday to Saturday, in the places where we live, aren't we chasing greed and selfishness, shortcuts and lies, just like the people of the world who do not know God at all? In church we are like angels, but at home and at work, haven't we completely forgotten our role as light and salt?
What the Lord truly wants from us is not big offering amounts or church titles. It is only "the worship of a holy life": repenting with a broken spirit, doing justice in our lives, loving mercy, and walking humbly with our God. The text sternly warns that faith not backed up by life is dead faith, nothing but self-deception.

■ 4. Main Message 3: The Ultimate Answer -
예수 그리스도를 통한 완전한 성취와 십자가의 복음: Complete fulfillment through Jesus Christ and the gospel of the cross
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Third, all these Old Testament laws and sacrifices, and the blood-stained cries of the prophets, are in the end focused on a single place, a single person.
Who is He? He is the one who two thousand years ago on the cross at Golgotha paid the price for all our sins in our place, who once for all and forever fulfilled the fearful curse and demands of the law with His torn flesh and shed blood, and who after three days broke the power of death, rose again and ascended: the King of kings, our Lord Jesus Christ.

All the words of the Old Testament are shadows and types of Jesus Christ who was to come. Jesus alone is the way, the truth and the life, the only way to come to God the Father.
Everyone, what is the gospel? The gospel is not a flimsy insurance policy for peace of mind, where we just call "Lord, Lord" with our lips and hold a ticket to heaven for when we die. The gospel is the holy power of life by which I died with Jesus on the cross and now live with Jesus Christ as the true King and Master of my life. When the gospel breaks into me, my values are turned upside down, my purpose in life changes, and I gladly take up my cross every day and joyfully obey His word.

Today's text is strongly inviting us, by the immeasurable grace of the cross and the power of the resurrection, to cut off our sinful old habits decisively and rise up boldly once again as a holy nation, a kingdom of priests.

Now let me close the message. Everyone, a head-knowledge faith that only hears with the ears and understands with the head just makes people endlessly proud; it never changes me or the world. Faith without works is dead.
